name: CogniVault
description: An adversarial research workspace for Criminal Justice, Forensic Psychology, and Public Policy. CogniVault replaces sycophantic AI with non-sycophantic personas (The Hostile Cross-Examiner, The Bureaucratic Realist, The Empirical Criminologist) to stress-test research briefs, courtroom depositions, and policy memos under Daubert standards, grant cliffs, and statistical controls.
